reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Removed the legacy `--log_rotate_*` flag options", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Existing --log_rotate_* flags in component configurations will no longer be recognized or honored after the upgrade to Istio 1.24.0.
consequence.remediation: Remove all --log_rotate_* flags from Istio component configurations and implement external log rotation using OS-level or sidecar-based log rotation tools.

proposed.statement: The legacy --log_rotate_* CLI flag options are removed in Istio 1.24.0; users must migrate to external log rotation tools.
